selection: Existing shared held-out instances are retained. Codex uses the latest available complete rerun for 13 environments from the project-maintainer-confirmed no-internet Codex Reruns collection: prefer synthesis replicate 42, otherwise the first available seed in 24, 222, 424, 444 order. Other methods and the remaining 15 Codex environments retain their original programs. Synthesis replicate seeds may differ; compared policies still use the same held-out instance, object count, and initial state. These selected examples are not representative averages. Missing program archives do not imply failure. Numerical results are transcribed separately from the paper.
playback: Frames sampled every 3 actions, encoded at 10 fps (30 actions per video second), with a one-second final hold. Same playback rate for all three methods; not wall-clock computation time.
rendering: Frozen archived programs replayed with their archived environment configurations. Scene backgrounds enabled wherever supported. All shown outcomes match archived evaluation outcomes. Captions report replay action counts; numerical result tables remain the original paper values.
